title: pteroloma triquetrum subsp. pseudotriquetrum
intro: Pteroloma triquetrum subsp. pseudotriquetrum, commonly known as Pseudotriquetrum, is a type of moss that belongs to the family Bryaceae. It is a non-vascular plant species that grows in acidic, moist environments. Pseudotriquetrum is valued for its health benefits, which include antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties that can help soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Pseudotriquetrum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities.
